query: Impact of refranchising on cost struc. & op. leverage under CBAs for The Coca-Cola Co.
final_answer: Refranchising shifts Coca‑Cola away from consolidated bottling/finished product operations (higher revenue, lower gross margin) toward concentrate operations (higher gross margin); in 2023, concentrate operations were 58% of net operating revenues vs 56% in 2022, while finished product operations fell to 42% vs 44%.
